judgement.reason: OpenClaw's gateway keeps its core state, memory and credentials on local disk with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, and Deployz containers start with an empty disk on every deploy.

evidence.quote: **Yours, with no catch.** State, memory, and credentials live on your hardware.
The [Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway) is the local control plane for sessions, tools, events, and channel connections.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ${OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR:-${HOME:-/tmp}/.openclaw}:/home/node/.openclaw (docker-compose.yml openclaw-gateway), volume ${OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR:-${HOME:-/tmp}/.openclaw}:/home/node/.openclaw (docker-compose.yml openclaw-cli)
reviews.reason: The mounted ~/.openclaw directory holds the gateway's state, config, credentials and workspace, and no shown setting moves that data to PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or S3, so the app needs durable local storage.
